selection.verdict: NO VIABLE POINT. No stitch cell is both >= 1.25x faster end-to-end than the large model and more accurate than the small model at 95% confidence. The small model scores 73.3% and already runs 2.48x faster end-to-end than large. Best stitch accuracy was 82.2% [68.7%-90.7%] at L8->L14 (warm, 1.22x end-to-end). 19/24 points are dominated by the small model outright; the rest buy accuracy only by giving up the speedup that motivates stitching at all.
